def render(self) -> str:
    imports = []
    for module in sorted(self.imports.keys()):
        names = sorted(self.imports[module])
        if module == "_io":
            module = module[1:]
        if len(names) == 1:
            imports.append("from %s import %s" % (module, names[0]))
